cards.target: İşe yürüyerek gidiyorum, yakın.
cards.english: I walk to work, it's close.

cards.target: Eve döndüğümde çok yorgundum.
cards.english: When I returned home I was very tired.

cards.target: Amcaoğlumla aynı okulda okuduk.
cards.english: I went to the same school as my cousin.

cards.target: Erken kalksaydım otobüsü kaçırmazdım.
cards.english: If I had gotten up early I wouldn't have missed the bus.

cards.target: Yemek hazır olursa haber ver.
cards.english: If the food is ready let me know.

cards.target: Doktor olsaydım insanlara yardım ederdim.
cards.english: If I were a doctor I would help people.

cards.target: Mavi gömlek kırmızıdan daha ucuz.
cards.english: The blue shirt is cheaper than the red one.

cards.target: Taksi bulamadım, sonunda yürüyerek gittim.
cards.english: I couldn't find a taxi, in the end I walked.

cards.target: Param olsa dünyayı gezmek isterdim.
cards.english: If I had money I would want to travel the world.

cards.target: Kuzenlerimle her yaz denize giderdik.
cards.english: We used to go to the sea with my cousins every summer.

cards.target: Eğer yardıma ihtiyacın olursa beni ara.
cards.english: If you need help call me.

cards.target: Her gün metroya binip işe giderim.
cards.english: I take the metro to work every day.

cards.target: Yumurtalı ekmek çocukların bayıldığı bir kahvaltılık.
cards.english: Egg bread is a breakfast item that children love.

cards.target: Para biriktirirsem gelecek yıl tatile gideceğim.
cards.english: If I save money I'll go on vacation next year.

cards.target: Zamanım olsa her gün kitap okurdum.
cards.english: If I had time I would read a book every day.

cards.target: Randevuma geç kaldım çünkü otobüs gelmedi.
cards.english: I was late for my appointment because the bus didn't come.

cards.target: O dün yemek pişirdi ve çok yoruldu.
cards.english: He cooked yesterday and got very tired.

cards.target: Küçük kızım okula yeni başladı, çok heyecanlı.
cards.english: My little daughter just started school, very excited.

cards.target: Babam bazen fotoğraf çekti ve çok yoruldu.
cards.english: My dad sometimes took photos and got very tired.

cards.target: Yeni açılan kütüphane çok modern ve güzel.
cards.english: The newly opened library is very modern and beautiful.

cards.target: Öğretmen bazen fotoğraf çekti ama pek beğenmedi.
cards.english: The teacher sometimes took photos but didn't really like them.

cards.target: Bu kitabı yazan yazar çok ünlü birisi.
cards.english: The author who wrote this book is a very famous person.

cards.target: Kütüphane okulun yanında, her gün oraya giderim.
cards.english: The library is next to the school, I go there every day.

cards.target: Yılbaşında ailece pasta keseriz ve dileklerde bulunuruz.
cards.english: On New Year's we cut cake as a family and make wishes.

cards.target: Biz her zaman tatilde fotoğraf çeker ve eve hatıra getiririz.
cards.english: We always take photos on vacation and bring home souvenirs.

cards.target: Annemin yaptığı börek her zaman çok lezzetli olur.
cards.english: The pastry my mother makes is always very delicious.

cards.target: Evde mi yemek istersin yoksa dışarı mı çıkalım?
cards.english: Would you rather eat at home or go out?

cards.target: Annem geçen hafta yemek pişirdi ve sonra uyudu.
cards.english: My mom cooked last week and then took a nap.

cards.target: O öğleden sonra fotoğraf çekti ve eve döndü.
cards.english: He took photos in the afternoon and went home.

cards.target: Bu sokakta gece geç saatlerde yürümek güvenli değil.
cards.english: Walking late at night on this street is not safe.

cards.target: Deniz kenarında taze hava ve temiz su bulabilirsiniz.
cards.english: By the seaside you can find fresh air and clean water.

cards.target: Diş hekimi sık sık arabasını temizler.
cards.english: The dentist often cleans his car.

cards.target: İyi bir yemekten sonra garsona her zaman bahşiş bırakırım.
cards.english: I always tip the waiter after a good meal.

cards.target: Avukat her sabah göl kenarında telefonla konuşur.
cards.english: The lawyer talks on the phone by the lake every morning.

cards.target: Çocuğum okuldan eve gülerek geldi, sınavdan iyi not almış.
cards.english: My child came home from school laughing, got a good grade on the exam.

cards.target: Yağmura rağmen dışarı çıktık.
cards.english: We went out despite the rain.

cards.target: Şirketimiz yeni pazarlara açılıyor.
cards.english: Our company is expanding to new markets.

cards.target: Doktora gitseydin şimdiye iyileşirdin.
cards.english: If you had gone to the doctor you would have recovered by now.

cards.target: Oğlum futbol oynuyor, çok yetenekli.
cards.english: My son plays football, he's very talented.

cards.target: Yeğenim bu yıl okula başlayacak.
cards.english: My nephew will start school this year.

cards.target: Bahçeye bir zeytin ağacı diktik.
cards.english: We planted an olive tree in the garden.

cards.target: Psikolog gün batımında işini bankada bitirdi.
cards.english: The psychologist finished his work at the bank at sunset.

cards.target: Haberlere göre yarın kar yağacakmış.
cards.english: According to the news, it will apparently snow tomorrow.

cards.target: Bahçede oynayan çocuklar komşunun çocukları.
cards.english: The children playing in the garden are the neighbor's children.

cards.target: Hava güzel olursa plaja gideriz.
cards.english: If the weather is nice, we will go to the beach.

cards.target: Su tasarrufu yapmak herkesin görevi olmalıdır.
cards.english: Saving water should be everyone's duty.

cards.target: Onlar bazen yemek pişirdi sonra dinlendi.
cards.english: They sometimes cooked and then rested.

cards.target: İnternetten sipariş ettiğim ürün yanlış geldi.
cards.english: The product I ordered online arrived in the wrong condition.

cards.target: Diş hekimi geçen yıl arabasını sattı.
cards.english: The dentist sold his car last year.

cards.target: Kütüphaneci doğru kitabı bulmama yardım etti.
cards.english: The librarian helped me find the right book.

cards.target: Haberlere göre deprem çok şiddetli olmuş.
cards.english: According to the news, the earthquake was very strong.

cards.target: Fiyat uygun olursa bu evi alalım.
cards.english: If the price is reasonable let's buy this house.

cards.target: Yarın kar yağarsa okullar tatil olur.
cards.english: If it snows tomorrow, the schools will be closed.

cards.target: Çiçekçiden anneme güzel bir buket aldım.
cards.english: I bought my mother a beautiful bouquet from the florist.

cards.target: Babam gençken çok sportif bir insanmış.
cards.english: My father was apparently a very athletic person when young.

cards.target: Çocuklarımızın geleceği için fedakarlık yapmaktan çekinmemeliyiz.
cards.english: We shouldn't hesitate to make sacrifices for our children's future.

cards.target: Duyduğuma göre yeni bir market açılacakmış.
cards.english: I heard that a new market is going to open.

cards.target: Bu mahalledeki çocuklar akşamları sokakta oynuyor.
cards.english: The children in this neighborhood play on the street in the evenings.

cards.target: Bugün yirmi üç nisan, ulusal egemenlik bayramı.
cards.english: Today is April twenty-third, national sovereignty holiday.

cards.target: Sahilde kuşlar her sabah güzel şarkılar söylüyor.
cards.english: On the beach birds sing beautiful songs every morning.

cards.target: Sinemaya gidelim mi, güzel bir film var.
cards.english: Should we go to the cinema? There's a good film on.

cards.target: Balıkçı şafakta denize açıldı ve lüfer tuttu.
cards.english: The fisherman went to sea at dawn and caught bluefish.

cards.target: Eğer gök gürültüsü olmazsa, tatil köyüne gideriz.
cards.english: If there is no thunderstorm, we will go to the holiday village.

cards.target: Sana anlattığım hikâye gerçek bir olaydan alınma.
cards.english: The story I told you is taken from a real event.

cards.target: Öğrenciler yazın alışveriş merkezinden bir dergi aldı.
cards.english: The students bought a magazine from the shopping mall in summer.

cards.target: Dükkandan aldığım gömlek küçük geldi, değiştirmem lazım.
cards.english: The shirt I bought from the shop was too small, I need to exchange it.

cards.target: Dün alışveriş merkezinde çok rahat bir eldiven buldum.
cards.english: Yesterday I found a very comfortable pair of gloves at the shopping center.

cards.target: Şehir merkezinde eski bir çeşme var, yüzyıllardır akıyor.
cards.english: In the city center there's an old fountain, flowing for centuries.

cards.target: Öğretmen her pazar spor salonunda antrenmanını bitirir.
cards.english: The teacher finishes his workout at the gym every Sunday.

cards.target: Annemin annesi doksan yaşında, Allah uzun ömür versin.
cards.english: My mother's mother is ninety, may God grant her a long life.

cards.target: Bu mahallede büyük bir ağaç var, herkes altında oturur.
cards.english: In this neighborhood there's a big tree, everyone sits under it.

cards.target: Eğer tsunami erken tespit edilse kıyıdaki halk tahliye edilirdi.
cards.english: If the tsunami were detected early, the coastal people would be evacuated.

cards.target: Şehir merkezinde büyük bir ağaç var, herkes altında oturur.
cards.english: In the city center there's a big tree, everyone sits under it.

cards.target: Daha çocukken müzikle tanışmış ve o günden beri hiç bırakmamış.
cards.english: He/She was introduced to music as a child and never stopped since.

cards.target: Söylentiye göre o ressam çok fakirmiş.
cards.english: According to rumor, that painter was very poor.

cards.target: Antibiyotikler keşfedilmeseydi enfeksiyon hastalıkları tedavi edilemezdi.
cards.english: If antibiotics hadn't been discovered, infectious diseases couldn't be treated.

cards.target: Arkeolog antik sarayın bodrum katındaki fosilleri kataloglar.
cards.english: The archaeologist catalogs fossils in the basement of the ancient palace.

cards.target: Fotoğrafçı bu akşam konser salonunda fotoğraf çekti.
cards.english: The photographer took photos at the concert hall this evening.

cards.target: Aşçı bu sabah alışveriş merkezinden malzeme aldı.
cards.english: The chef bought ingredients from the shopping mall this morning.

cards.target: Çevirmen romanın tüm bölümlerini üç farklı dile çevirmiş.
cards.english: The translator has translated all chapters of the novel into three different languages.

cards.target: Hafta sonu görüşelim.
cards.english: Let's meet on the weekend.

cards.target: Lütfen yavaş konuşun.
cards.english: Please speak slowly.
